programme.title: A sit down with Johnny Arlee
programme.desc: Host Jana Waller sits down with Jeremiah Johnson star, Johnny Arlee and talks about the chain of events that led him to getting a role in a movie that changed his life forever. This raw uncut interview will give the viewer a whole new appreciation for an American classic.

programme.title: Osceola Close Encounter
programme.desc: Host Jana Waller heads to Florida with her T/C Encore single shot in hopes of connecting on her first Osceola. Justin Strickland, owner of Strickly Outdoors wastes no time in introducing Jana to a close- encounter of the bearded kind.

programme.title: The Spotted Hyena Project
programme.desc: Host Jana Waller gets up close and personal with several spotted hyenas in South Africa and learns more about the conservation behind this incredible and often demonized species.

programme.title: In Search of Sharks Teeth
programme.desc: Host Jana Waller combs the beaches of West Florida in search of prehistoric shark teeth.

programme.title: Montana griz encounter
programme.desc: Host Jana Waller encounters a mating pair of grizzlies while searching for spring bears with her buddy Paul Servey.

programme.title: BOWFISHING BONANZA PART II
programme.desc: Jana is back in Texas with AMS Bowfishing's Matt Schillinger. It's an action packed couple of days hunting hogs, turkey, and a giant alligator gar!

programme.title: Bowfishing Zimbabwe Crocodile
programme.desc: One of the coolest shots ever filmed with a bow and arrow. You don't want to miss this exciting Crocodile hunt from Zimbabwe. Follow along as VP of AMS Bowfishing Jeff Braun tucks away in a ground blind and waits patiently for a shot of a lifetime at an African Crocodile. The AMS gear does exactly what its meant to do.

programme.title: Giants in Green Bay
programme.desc: Mathew is joined by Cindy Braun the CEO of AMS Bowfishing as they travel to Green Bay Wisconsin in pursuit of giant common carp. Also known as Title Town USA home of the Green Bay Packers but also giant Carp. Also known for its world class Walleye fishing, these invasive carp must be kept in check as they destroy spawning habitat for the native fish. Non-stop bowfishing action as the Giants of Green Bay move into the shallows and make for some great night time bowfishing.

programme.title: Where The Buffalo Roam Part 1
programme.desc: In this episode Mathew heads down to Kentucky to meet up with Dennis Redden in pursuit of big buffalo. As the suns rays warm up the water temperatures the action picks up and they connect on a giant 74 pounder.

programme.title: Where The Buffalo Roam Part 2
programme.desc: Don't miss the exciting conclusion of Where the Buffalo Roam Part 2. Dennis's grandboys Ty and Cody join on some bowfishing fun and if you thought the 74 pound Buffalo was big in part one, wait until you see. Well you'll just have to watch and find out.

programme.title: Tidal Water Rays Part 1
programme.desc: Mathew heads east to Delaware to chase some stingrays with his good friend Corey Brossman. We will show you the gear we use, the type of sting rays we target, and how to prepare them for the grill.

programme.title: Tidal Water Rays Part 2
programme.desc: Tidal Water Rays Part 2. Now its time to get after those GIANT Butterfly Rays. We put the AMS gear to work as these beast can weigh over 150 pounds and have a wingspan over 5 feet. These Butterfly Rays make for great table fare as we also show how to prepare them for the grill. Plus Collins gets a special gift.

programme.title: Chasin' Grassies
programme.desc: Lets turn back the clock and head south and chase some Grass Carp with our good buddy Dennis Redden.

programme.title: Twisted Limbs
programme.desc: Brody takes out a friend with Twisted Limbs bowfishing in Florida for some amazing bowfishing in both fresh and saltwater

programme.title: East Coast Mixed Bag
programme.desc: The boys hit the east coast waters and get a mixed bag of Rays, Gar, Snakeheads, and Catfish and put the AMS gear to work.

programme.title: The Kids
programme.desc: Its the Kids turn for a little bowfishing fun as we are joined by Garrett, Kayla, and their mother Stephanie Drexler. The kids enjoy some daytime shooting and then get to experience bowfishing under the lights. The action heats up as some giant common carp get a free boat ride and the kids shoot their biggest fish to date.

programme.title: History of the AMS Big 20
programme.desc: Travel back in time with us this week as we relive the trials and tribulations that come with hosting one of the nation's biggest bowfishing tournaments. We navigate through the timeline of a tournament that started down in Brandenburg KY in 2011, with 40 boats participating, to a tournament that now regularly hosts 80+ boats up here in Wisconsin. The AMS Big 20 Challenge is now considered one of the premier events in the bowfishing world. Sit back, relax, and enjoy the roller coaster 13-year journey that has made the tournament what it is today.

programme.title: Calling All Gators
programme.desc: Its Big Game Bowfishing time down on Florida as we hook up with Jana Waller host of Skull Bound Chronicles and Orlando Gator Hunts. We put the gator calls to work as we try to get Alligators to come close enough for a shot. We also explain the AMS Big Game equipment that it takes to successfully harvest an Alligator.

programme.title: Mr. Kentucky 2 – Dennis Redden (Ep. 68)
programme.desc:
This week we sit down with long time AMS Bowfishing family member and owner of Redden Outfitters in Kentucky, Dennis Redden. Dennis recaps his 2023 guiding season and how bowfishing in Kentucky has changed over the years.
We also discuss:
• Biggest learning curve for first time bowfishers
• Dennis' thoughts on Worlds 2024 being held in Kentucky
• Redden family bowfishing memories
• Best days on the water so far in 2023
PLUS!
• What should be the punishment for the loser of AMS Fantasy Football League? (You're going to want to hear this!) ?

programme.title: Silver Carp-Multi Billion Dollar Threat/BAA Prez Christina Hayden (70)
programme.desc: How much money is spent on keeping Silver Carp out of the Great Lakes? You will be shocked plus newly appointed Bowfishing Association of America President Christina Hayden joins us. Its October so get out there and enjoy the outdoors. Its a beautiful time of the year to be on the water or in the woods. It'll put a smile on your face.

programme.title: Nacho Stingrays
programme.desc: Mathew from AMS Bowfishing invites Julie McQueen CEO of Carbon TV and Jana Waller host of Skull Bound Chronicles to the east coast for some bowfishing for Stingray. They meet up with Brossman Boys Bowfishing and Corey Brossman for some exciting tidal water action. Plus they show you how they prepare these rays for the grill. Nacho Stingrays coming right up...Eat them up Yum Yum!

programme.title: Common Fun
programme.desc: Mathew and Derrick head out on the Wisconsin River backwaters in search of spawning Common Carp. With the water temps reaching 65 degrees the fellas get a little giddy when they see whats happening in those backwaters. From the boat to sneaking up on Carp from the bank they sure had some Common Fun.

programme.title: The Hunt For the Giant
programme.desc: The story on how Mat from AMS bowfishing hunted down a GIANT butterfly stingray with his bowfishing gear

programme.title: Heart of a Giant-Brad Jordan
programme.desc: Diagnosed with MOPD Type 2 that effects 1 in 3 million people Brad Jordan stands at 38 inches and weighs 35 pounds and loves everything about the outdoors. At home Brad is not alone as his sister Bridgett stands at 27 inches and they are in the Guinness Book of World Records as the smallest siblings. Brad joins us and uses a crossbow for some amazing bowfishing action as he fills the tub with some big Wisconsin Buffs. Live Life to the Fullest!

programme.title: Texas Slough Surprise Part 1
programme.desc: Mathew and Jana head south to Texas and meet up with Buck Medley and hit up the Texas sloughs for some Longnose Gar. We show you how to fillet them out and deep fry them up for a tasty campfire delight.

programme.title: Texas River Slough Surprise Part 2
programme.desc: Part 2 Texas River Slough Surprise. Mathew and Jana are back on the water in search of Alligator Gar. With no luck on the big water they are down to their final 4 hours of the trip. The cameraman has already flown back home, Buck Medley went back to work, and Mathew and Jana have a plane to catch but decide to give it one more try down in the slough. Mathew finally connects on an Alligator Gar and tries his best to get all the action from his cell phone. Who knew that Texas Slough had fish that big in it.

programme.title: Slamm'n Salmon
programme.desc: Mathew heads west to South Dakota to meet up with AMS Staffers Ty Smith and Mark Morrison for some fall Salmon Bowfishing. South Dakota allows bowfishers the same opportunity as hook and line anglers to harvest a 5 possession daily bag limit. We tour the Whitlock Bay spawning station and talk with Bob Henton South Dakota Fisheries Biologist about the Chinook Salmon program and then head out for a chance to harvest a Salmon with our bow and arrow. Slamm'n Salmon, how cool is that.

programme.title: Boise Butterflys
programme.desc: The Snake River near Boise Idaho is home to many fish species but one in particular that we are after, the Butterfly Carp. We meet up Travis and Jenni Oviatt owners of Grinz N Finz guide service and Jana Waller host of Skull Bound Chronicles to see if we can check the Butterfly Carp off our bucket list. The early March cold temperatures, snow, and beautiful sunsets set the stage for these Flames of Fire the Butterfly Carp.

programme.title: Chasing the Push
programme.desc: Water erupts, backs and fins break the water surface, and large V-shaped wakes in the shallow water signal the annual Buffalo spawn. Derrick and Mathew get word that the spawn is on and don't hesitate to load the boat and head south to Chase the Push. Plus, we show you how to fillet and deep fry Buffalo for the table. Buffalo, eat them up Yum Yum.

programme.title: IT'S EPISODE 100 BABY! Interviews w/ AMS Crew, + Landon Conley & Giveaways (Ep. 100)
programme.desc:
Celebrate Episode 100 with us this week! We give away all kinds of gift cards, apparel, and gear! We also interview all the staff here at AMS, talk with Landon Conley, the 2024 Youth Bowfisher of the Year, AND play all the video submissions we received in the last week. Matt also shocks the world with yet ANOTHER bowfishing song that he heard while driving back from a night on the water. Get ready, the Roche A Cri River Rat has come out with a new bowfishing banger.
PLUS! ??
• Buff bet update
• AMS Boat improvements for 2025
• AMS Big 20 is RIGHT around the corner
• We hear from Waterboy's Bobby Bouche!?

programme.title: Brody's 30 Part 1
programme.desc: 12 year old Brody Brossman and his Dad Corey Brossman travel 970 miles to Wisconsin as Brody has a goal set at putting a 30 pound Carp in the boat. Shooting a Common Carp over 30 pounds can take weeks, months, even years so trying to get Brody a 30 in two days was going to be a challenge.

programme.title: Brody's 30 Part 2
programme.desc: Brody, Corey, and Mathew are back on the water to see what fish lurk below the water during the day. They have to make quick work as storms are slowly moving in from the west. To their surprise the Buffalo start to push and spawn sprinkled in with some Carp. Brody shoots his first daytime fish and first Buffalo as Mathew slips on the light rail and ends up in the water.

programme.title: Tails on the Muddy Flats
programme.desc: Stalking fish while bowfishing?? That's right, when you hear the word bowfishing you think about fast paced, always on the move, covering ground but on this trip to Kentucky, Mathew and Dennis stalk feeding Grass Carp on the Muddy Flats. Stalking fish puts the hunt back in Bowfishing.

programme.title: CARP DIEM-WISCONSIN BOWFISHING
programme.desc: Jana meets up with Jules McQueen in her home state of Wisconsin for an action packed few days on the water with Matt Schillinger and Derrick Schmidt of AMS Bowfishing.

programme.title: Underwater Lueys Part 1
programme.desc: Tim Wells chases Big Lueys in the woods, but now its time to chase Big Lueys under the water. Tim travels north and meets up with Mathew with AMS Bowfishing and the search is on for giant Buffalo or should we say Underwater Lueys.

programme.title: DOUBLE DOUBLE
programme.desc: Chris and Parker Gade and other family members head to Wyoming on a DIY antelope hunt!! They had a double double good time!!

programme.title: BIG POND BRUISERS
programme.desc: Lee Schneider and Zach Haas are heading back out onto Lake Michigan with Captain Fluffy in search of king salmon, coho, rainbows, or whatever else wants to bite!! Once we hit that magic hour, the action was non-stop!!!

programme.title: COLD TO HOT!
programme.desc: Once again we head to Sheboygan County Wisconsin for the Learn to Hunt program for turkeys! There was some snow, some cold temps, but things heated up fast!!!

programme.title: LOW LIGHT SUCCESS PT 1
programme.desc: Parker Gade drew a Wisconsin bear tag, and he and his dad (Chris) show us how they hunt bear. Part 1 shows us how they pick and set up spots!

programme.title: LOW LIGHT SUCCESS PT 2
programme.desc: We continue with Parker Gade and his quest for a Wisconsin black bear with his dad Chris. No one said it would be easy!

programme.title: TURKEY TRIFECTA?
programme.desc: Eric Schmitz has 3 Wisconsin turkey tags!! Will he use his bow, gun, or both? Will he fill all 3 tags? Lots of info and excitement in this 2 part series!

programme.title: ECUADOR PART 1: THE FORGOTTEN FRONTIER
programme.desc:
Wildlife Photographer and Filmmaker Ian Breland heads into a remote region of the Ecuadorian Amazon situated between the lower-altitude Amazon Basin and the snowy, towering peaks of the Andes. Ian and the professionals he's with are in search of rare, undescribed, and iconic reptile & amphibian species; many of which are found nowhere else on Earth.
Despite being roughly the size of the state of Colorado, Ecuador harbors nearly 7% of the entire planet's biodiversity. This small but packed gem is currently the 17th most biodiverse country on the planet, though new discoveries and rediscoveries are rolling in every year- from plants, fish, and frogs to snakes and even mammals. The unique rainforests of Ecuador are equally as imperiled and silently exploited as they are exotic, and we must act now to both preserve and ethically appreciate what lies in the Forgotten Frontier.

programme.title: GUATEMALA PART II: LOST IN PERFECTION
programme.desc:
The guys are in the middle of their Central American expedition, now entrenched within the absurdly rich Caribbean jungles surrounded by cloud forests with diverse green valleys. They hike all day and night through the rainforest, searching for primarily Eyelash Vipers, Coral Snakes, and Jumping Pit Vipers.
The second the team arrives, they realize that the snake density is through the roof, and conditions are ideal. The first night yields tons of snakes, even one that no one can identify. It seems every nook and cranny has something beautiful, and they guys are almost as happily exhausted as they are stoked.

programme.title: PERUVIAN AMAZON PART 1: MOTHER OF GOD
programme.desc:
Madre De Dios translates to "Mother of God" in Spanish- a name more appropriate to none other than this region of Peru. Situated in the SW Amazon Basin, it remains one of the most understudied, inaccessible, and wild expanses of life on Earth. Unlike the area we explored in Ecuador, this part of the Amazon sits at a lower elevation- meaning that the more herpetologically favorable climate sustains an unfathomably elevated level of biodiversity.
Ian, Mike, and Sean (joined by their extra cameraman Tyler Velasquez) venture into protected territory alongside the snaking (and snakey) Las Piedras river in search of all things herps. The country is home to over 400 species (and counting) of reptiles alone, and the area is generally accepted as a world class Field Herping mecca.
The guys don't have any specific targets besides EVERYTHING, and waste no time jumping into the bush alongside a myriad of resident naturalists and friends to see what can be uncovered.

programme.title: ECUADOR PART II: EXPLORING THE UNDISCOVERED
programme.desc:
Wildlife Photographer and Filmmaker Ian Breland is back in a remote region of the Ecuadorian Amazon- situated between the lower-altitude Amazon Basin and the snowy, towering peaks of the Andes. Ian and the professionals he's with are in search of rare, undescribed, and iconic reptile & amphibian species; many of which are found nowhere else on Earth.
This time though, they're searching specifically for some incredible frog, toad, and salamander species. What they uncover is nothing short of mesmerizing.
Despite being roughly the size of the state of Colorado, Ecuador harbors nearly 7% of the entire planet's biodiversity. This small but packed gem is currently the 17th most biodiverse country on the planet, though new discoveries and rediscoveries are rolling in every year- from plants, fish, and frogs to snakes and even mammals. The unique rainforests of Ecuador are equally as imperiled and silently exploited as they are exotic, and we must act now to both preserve and ethically appreciate what lies in the Forgotten Frontier.

programme.title: PERUVIAN AMAZON PART II: DON'T LOSE THE FOREST THROUGH THE TREES
programme.desc:
Still in the Amazon, the team is rolling from one encounter to the next. Each find lights their eyes up like fireworks and keeps everyone pushing forward. With only a week left to experience pure bliss, it's all hands on deck for the better part of 24 hours a day. The final find though- no one imagined it would be so sweet.
While a quick dip into the largest rainforest on Earth may render one to conjure thoughts of their surroundings being immortal and indestructible- the truth is a sobering one. Roughly 1,100 square miles of Peru's forests are cut down every year—around 80% of them illegally. Fires burn where they shouldn't, uncontacted indigenous are pushed out of their homes, the sun gazes hotter, the rains hit harder. The main culprits of deforestation are small-scale agriculture, commercial mining and related road construction, and forest degradation is caused primarily by illegal logging.
The scars across Peru are visible from space, and if we can't sustainably progress while keeping love at the forefront of our decisions- the necessary prescription for biodiversity is annihilation.

programme.title: COLORADO: SUBTERRANEAN WONDERS
programme.desc:
Ian, Sean, and Mike's search for reptiles and amphibians lands them in an astoundingly rich haven which also happens to be the most threatened ecosystem on earth: Prairie Grasslands.
The nearly destroyed grasslands of Eastern Colorado may not seem like much to your average mall crawler, but if one just looks a little bit closer- you'll spot a wonderland unlike any other. Some of the planet's most striking snakes fill the caverns beneath your feet, with impressively venomous vipers blessing the ground you traverse.
The team wanders hours on end through grassy plains, flipping debris for a shot at revealing a glimpse into the world witnessed by few and appreciated by all find it.

programme.title: GUATEMALA PART III: VALLEY OF DRAGONS
programme.desc:
Nearing the end of their Guatemala expedition, the team has one final (and impatiently awaited) location- the driest region in all of Central America, Motagua Valley. The valley resembles the boys' home, Arizona in uncanny ways- though it's uniqueness is unmatched.
The dry, shrubby hillsides are home to one of the planet's most critically endangered endemic species, the venomous Guatemalan Beaded Lizard. The group stays on a reserve (Reserva Natural Heloderma) in the last remaining fragments of the valley's ecosystem, and catch an incredible opportunity to see the lizards up close and help in the vital process of rewilding them in hopes that the population may stabilize.
They're also searching for a lifelong dream, the Central American Rattlesnake. The snake is almost more of a dragonesque creature than our lizard friends, and certainly a more imposing one.
The team expects hunting the rattlesnakes down to become a major struggle; yet they discover that despite massive habitat degradation and human impact, the valley is far more dense in reptilian concentration than anyone had anticipated.
There is still so much left to see- and save.

programme.title: GUATEMALA PART 1: GUARDIANS OF THE CLOUD FOREST
programme.desc:
Guatemala sits in a Neotropical transitional area that connects South America to North America, through a narrowly winding stream of land with varying altitudes and landscapes that we've come to call Central America.
Ian, Mike, and Trent link up with Wildlife Photographer Andres Novales to travel across the country, targeting the different legendary and threatened species in each region. First, they tackle the prehistoric cloud forests, high altitude mountainous jungles that have fostered the evolution of many different venomous tree-dwelling pit vipers. The biggest targets here are the Yellow-blotched Palm Pit Viper and the Guatemalan Palm Pit Viper.
Stumbling through year's worth of decaying plant matter and vibrant palms towering over the group, they hike into unknown territory with big plans.

programme.title: CALIFORNIA: LAVA MONSTERS
programme.desc:
The gang continues on their road trip through the seemingly endless Sonoran Desert, seeking out deeply remote and arid regions. They head to a stunningly dry and convincingly sparse mountain range nested near the Mexico border in search of the esteemed white-phase Speckled Rattlesnake; soon moving on into Southern California.
The guys meet up with fellow herper, History Channel show host, and good friend Rob Alleva to track down a snake some in the group have only seen photos of- though none of them could have foreseen what they end up running into.
The final, and arguably most incredible pit stop of the trip is an ancient volcanic lava field. Here lies the main target of their 2-week blitz, the "lava-phase Speckled Rattlesnake". Harboring a nearly black color scheme known only from this specific area due to some fast paced evolution, these jaw dropping animals sometimes prove to be almost as hard to track down as they are pleasing to the eye.

programme.title: Aoudads & Diaper Bags
programme.desc: Getting eyes on a 30" aoudad ram is hard enough, Hunter Hill is chasing big Texas rams with a four week old baby girl and two young boys. Together with her husband Clay and good friend Cari Goss the crew takes it one step at a time to finally put some great rams in their crosshairs.

programme.title: Through Grit & Glory
programme.desc: One foot in front of the other is easier said than done on a 10 day dall sheep hunt in the remote mountains of British Columbia. Between a rock and a hard place Cari Goss is accustomed to putting in the effort to get hands on a legal ram. However this go round she is going to have to push through the grit to find the glory.

programme.title: Chasing Legends
programme.desc: Knowing a great buck is in the area is only half the battle, locating, stalking and sealing the deal is the other half. Everything either lines up or falls apart when chasing legends.

programme.title: Early Season TURKEY HUNT In Mississippi, Improving Mountain Habitat With Andy Melton | Chasing Red
programme.desc: Chasing Red is back for another turkey season and with opening day's around the country arriving, the excitement is super high around here. Kicking this episode off are team members Andy Melton and David Williams. The guys cover some great early season habitat tips, reflect on some of their hunts from last season, and look ahead to their upcoming trip in Florida where they'll be hunting Osceolas in the coming days. Following that we're heading down to Mississippi for Casen Holmes final youth season hunt with his dad Chad behind the camera. The gobblers do it right and the duo punch the first tag for the team this season. We're excited to bring this series to you again and as always, thank you for the support.

programme.title: Turkey Hunting TOUGH Conditions In Florida, A First Ever Gobbler In Georgia | Chasing Red
programme.desc: On this episode of Chasing Red, we're kicking things off by heading south to the state of Florida where team members Andy Melton and David Williams are turkey hunting for Osceola gobblers. The conditions have been extremely tough due to the prolonged heat but the duo gives their all and by the end, a long spurred tom is in range. Following this, we're jumping over to Georgia where longtime team member Dell Kirby is taking his grandsons hunting hoping to build another memory.

programme.title: Curved Spurred Gobbler In Florida, Turkey Hunting Curse Broken For Chad
programme.desc: We're kicking off a brand new season of Chasing Red down in Florida with Chad Holmes as he tries to break the turkey hunting curse that's been following him for the past year. After wrapping up Sunday service, Chad and the guys head south driving overnight 13 hours to make it in time for the morning hunt. This one is another example of how always being ready can make or break getting a shot and Chad does just that! Upon walking up on his gobbler, Chad spots a curved spur kicking off a great start to the '24 hunting season.

programme.title: Illinois Atypical State Record Turkey
programme.desc: Jake takes the Illinois atypical state turkey record with his bow on the first day of the season.

programme.title: Cow Patty Toms
programme.desc: Latisha Phipps hammers a tom in the cow pastures of Kentucky and Logan Roepke connects on a great bird in the youth turkey season in Illinois.

programme.title: Whitetail Sheds and Deads 2015 Part 1
programme.desc: Finding whitetail shed antlers is what we look forward to after hunting season closes. This year we were pleasantly surprised to find a lot of sheds and less deads - a change we welcomed.

programme.title: Whitetail Sheds and Deads 2015 Part 2
programme.desc: Team Radical is finding more antlers.

programme.title: Velvet Whitetails
programme.desc: Watching whitetails in velvet throughout the Midwest during the summer months is something we look forward to every year. After finding the bucks, which are usually in the soybeans, we wait for the perfect timing to move in and get close up to these magnificent animals.

programme.title: Please Stand Up
programme.desc: After whistling and doing everything Kirk could do the Mule Deer buck finally stood from his bed offering a close shot. Kirk was able to wrap his tag around his first set of Mule Deer antlers.

programme.title: Bass Fishing with a Simple Walmart Bass Fishing Rod, Reel and Tackle Setup
programme.desc:
Need a quick and easy bass rod and reel setup? So did I! While out of town in Moultrie, Georgia for business, I forgot my bass rod and tackle at home, so I ran to the local Walmart and bought just what I needed for a great price. Walk with me as I pick out which bass fishing rod I prefer and why, than the lures I think would work best for bass while here in Moultrie, Georgia.
After purchasing my bass fishing rod and bass tackle from Walmart for a great price, I head on over to a local pond near the hotel I am staying at in Moultrie, Georgia. I than set up my new Lew's Speed Stick rod by attaching the Abu Garcia reel I bought to it. Then I string my Spiderwire braided fishing line through my new pole and attach some 20 pound mono to the end. After that I tie a size 3/0 Mustad offset hook to my line, put on split slide weights, and I am ready for the lure! I bought two different types of rubber worms. Purple Powerbaits and Watermelon Yum Dingers.
I am ready to catch some bass! On Day 1, I used the Watermelon worms and caught three gorgeous Georgia Bass! On Day 2 I tried to switch up to the purple and didn't get a single hit. Switched back to the Watermelon worms and caught a bass almost instantly!

programme.title: Hunting the Rut in Mississippi - Part 1
programme.desc:
Hunting the Rut in Mississippi - Part 1
Husband and wife team, Reese & Amber Richards (owners of Bearded Outdoors) go on their first ever out of state hunt together to north Mississippi on the quest to harvest Amber's first buck ever! This is a two part series, so be sure you're following Bearded Outdoors so you don't miss Part 2!
"We were invited by the owners of Conviction Outdoors to come hunt their gorgeous rolling hills on almost 200 acres of private family land. They stayed in the cabin on the property as well which was hand built by the owner himself. Absolutely gorgeous! We were so blessed to have had this opportunity and we enjoyed the property, food, and fellowship very much! To have been invited back was icing on the cake!"

programme.title: 200 Disabled Veterans go Deep Sea Fishing in the Gulf!
programme.desc:
We were invited by Iron Men Outdoor Ministries to attend their Annual Deep Sea Fishing with Disabled Veterans trip. These two days consisted of a banquet to raise money and honor all of the disabled veterans that were invited on the fishing trip, as well as a day on the water, deep sea fishing on several boats!
There ended up being 200 disabled veterans fishing! There were 20 total boats that took these men and women fishing! Three of these boats were 90 foot fishing charter vessels, and the rest were smaller charter boats. The total number of fish caught exceeded 2000! The total number of fish kept was about 1600!
This entire trip was amazing to say the least! Being asked to film and collect content of what it is that Iron Men Ministries does, as well as to capture these disabled vets having a blast catching fish, was such an honor and so humbling! We are already counting down the days till the next one!
Here are all the ways to connect with Iron Men Outdoors: Website: https://www.ironmenoutdoorministries.com/ Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/IMOM2013 Festus Potee: https://www.facebook.com/festus.potee

programme.title: Sight Unseen
programme.desc:
In the premiere episode of Modern Homestead, Janna Breslin and Evan DeMarco take the plunge into a world they've never known before, as they embark on a journey that promises to challenge their limits, expand their horizons, and redefine their very notions of homesteading. What begins as a bold venture to buy 120 acres in the picturesque Tennessee landscape quickly transforms into an eye-opening experience that neither of them could have anticipated.
The episode kicks off with excitement and a sense of adventure as Janna and Evan, an unlikely pair consisting of a cover model and a scientist, reveal their audacious plan to create a thriving homestead capable of withstanding even the most unexpected challenges - including a potential zombie apocalypse. Armed with enthusiasm and a determination to master the art of self-sufficiency, they set out to build their dream oasis where they will source their own water, grow their own food, generate energy, and construct their own shelter.
However, as the saying goes, reality often has other plans. What Janna and Evan initially perceive as a straightforward path to their modern homesteading vision takes an unexpected turn. As they explore their new purchase, they encounter challenges that leave them both baffled and humbled. The land they imagined to be a canvas of endless possibilities presents them with a unique set of obstacles they hadn't foreseen.
Amidst the breathtaking beauty of the Tennessee landscape, the duo faces unexpected revelations. The landscape itself is both enchanting and unpredictable, with its own stories etched into every rock and tree. With each twist and turn, Janna and Evan's perceptions of their journey shift, and they find themselves relying on each other's strengths more than ever before.
As they dive deeper into their new reality, the couple discovers that their homesteading adventure is about more than just mastering survival skills; it's about embracing the unknown, learning from failures, and celebrating triumphs no matter how small. The episode captures the candid moments of frustration, laughter, and perseverance as they navigate through the challenges of homesteading.

programme.title: The Blue Realm Ep110: The Ship Sinkers
programme.desc: Mothballed, de-commissioned naval vessels are toxic time-bombs, filled with PCB’s, asbestos, lead paint, oil and grease. Hundreds rust in dockyards around the world. programme.title: Journeys In Africa Ep206: Victoria Falls…The Smoke That Thunders
programme.desc: One of the 7 Natural Wonders of the World, Victoria Falls is an amazing spectacle that straddles the Zambia/Zimbabwe border. programme.desc: Liquid Edge leaps into canyon pools with the Deap Canyoning Team, captures a first waterfall descent with kayak superstar Steve Fisher, showcases surf cinematographer Larry Haynes, searches the world for secret surf spots via the film Planet Blow, and features an epic swell via Oakley’s Wave of the Winter.

programme.title: Journeys In Africa Ep206: Victoria Falls…The Smoke That Thunders
programme.desc: One of the 7 Natural Wonders of the World, Victoria Falls is an amazing spectacle that straddles the Zambia/Zimbabwe border. The force of the water is so intense that the water bouncing back creates a rainforest. Remarkably, the wildlife in the area is as abundant as the water going over the falls.

programme.title: The Surfing Lifestyle Ep104: In Search of Perfect Waves
programme.desc: A key component of The Surfing Lifestyle is to venture to lesser travelled parts of the world in search of perfect waves, and Dru Adler, Adam Bennetts and their surfboard shaper Daniel MacDonald, did exactly that in southern Sumatra where they found uncrowded perfection and adventure around every turn.

programme.title: The Blue Realm Ep110: The Ship Sinkers
programme.desc: Mothballed, de-commissioned naval vessels are toxic time-bombs, filled with PCB’s, asbestos, lead paint, oil and grease. Hundreds rust in dockyards around the world. What can be done with them? A team of Canadians has developed an innovative solution…they clean the ships...then sink them!

programme.title: Sportsman's Adventures: Kings of Texas
programme.desc: Captain Rick Murphy is on the troll for kingfish in Port Mansfield, Texas. Guiding him to the fish is Captain Chad Kinney from Texas Insider Fishing Report.

programme.desc: You can thank estrogen for keeping your lips full and plump and your body curvy. Today, we take a deep dive into the importance of estrogen, how it impacts our body, and the effects of having too much or too little can have on your health. You'll also learn ways to support your body's estrogen production, such as seed cycling, bioidentical hormone replacement therapy, and even by having more orgasms.

programme.title: Vinyasa for Life - Vinyasa for Life: From Cobra to Camel
programme.desc: This vinyasa class applies what you learned in Day 1 so you can play with classic backbends and steady transitions. Schuyler guides you through Cobra (Bhujangasana), Locust (Salabhasana), and Camel (Ustrasana), finishing off with Bridge (Setu Bandhasana) and spine-clearing twists. Take it slow and build strength!

programme.title: Gut Health with Dr. Mary Pardee - Day 3: IBS and other Gastrointestinal Issues
programme.desc: Today, we dive into the most commonly diagnosed functional GI disorder, Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS)

programme.title: Vinyasa for Life - Vinyasa for Life: Foundations of Forward Bending
programme.desc: In this class, you begin with a brief anatomy of forward folds, followed by a dive into Standing Forward Fold (Uttanasana) and Wide-Legged Forward Fold (Prasarita Padottanasana). Regardless of your flexibility, this lab is designed to help you to safely find length through the entire back chain of your body.

programme.title: Vinyasa for Life - Vinyasa for Life: Forward Bending for Forward Thinking
programme.desc: Use what you learned in Day 4 to stretch the hamstrings and your backbody safely and effectively. Bring attention to your spine in Downward Facing Dog (Adho Mukha Svanasana) and Intense Side Stretch (Parsvottanasana), before working on Hand-to-Big-Toe Pose (Padangusthasana) with a strap. Finish in a supported backbend to counter your diligent forward folding.

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency - Section 1: The Addiction Frequency & The Power of Breath
programme.desc: Breathing is the single most important thing we do. Addiction is characterized by a sense of lack, of missing something. And when you breathe poorly, like when anxious or angry, you’re caught up in your head and aren’t breathing well and that sends a signal to your body that perpetuates the addiction frequency. Deep, long breathing is how we interrupt this pattern.

programme.title: Ecstatic Breathwork - Feeling: Transforming Difficult Emotions
programme.desc: Everyone has difficult emotions, but we don’t have to turn these feelings into a big production.

programme.title: Yoga For All - Yoga For All Day 1: Notice
programme.desc: Your Day 1 practice offers an invitation to slow down and take stock.

programme.title: Yoga For All - Day 2: Befriend
programme.desc: Your Day 2 session invites you to use the tools of the at-home yoga practice to befriend your body and your breath. Build on the art of noticing from Day 1 as we expand our vocabulary with a focus on a strong foundation. This session encourages a healthy flow of energy up and down the spine and lovingly guides you to learn how to take responsibility for your experience on the mat.

programme.desc: Qigong is considered one of the five branches of Chinese Medicine, a foundational basis for martial arts, and a long-standing spiritual practice revered in Daoist and Zen traditions. programme.title: Qigong: The Eight Brocades - Qigong: The Eight Brocades - Day 2

programme.desc: Your hormones work like a symphony. When every instrument is in tune, they play harmoniously. This means clear skin, easier periods, less hot flashes, better sex, and more restful sleep. Yes, it can be that good when your hormones are in check.

programme.title: Balance Your Hormones with Dr. Jolene Brighten - Balance Your Hormones - Day 2: Adrenal Glands
programme.desc: This sentence sums it up: The adrenal glands are the foundation of hormone balancing. If your adrenals aren't functioning at full capacity, you'll feel it. In today's lesson, we take a deep dive into the hormones that our adrenal glands produce. We'll start to get an idea of why taking care of and keeping these glands happy is so important.

programme.title: Balance Your Hormones with Dr. Jolene Brighten - Balance Your Hormones - Day 3: The Thyroid
programme.desc: How common are thyroid conditions? Women are 5 to 8 times more likely than a man to develop thyroid disease. If your thyroid isn't functioning optimally, every single cell in your body will feel it, including your ovaries. A thyroid function that is too high or too low can lead to symptoms that include low heart rate, fatigue, weight loss, and menstrual irregularities.

programme.title: Balance Your Hormones with Dr. Jolene Brighten - Balance Your Hormones - Day 4: Progesterone
programme.desc: When it comes to having a calm, chilled-out mindset or the sweet feelings of love, you can thank progesterone. On the flip side, suboptimal levels of this hormone can cause you to have headaches, breast tenderness, inability to fall asleep, and painful or heavy periods. Together, we'll learn what you can do to get your body producing the right amount of progesterone. Because this hormone is everything when it comes to feeling at peace.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - This Is Why You 'Can’t Lose Weight'
programme.desc: The media tells you, 'Don’t worry! You’re big and you’re beautiful.' That you are healthy at any size. Nice to hear, but it simply isn’t true. Pharma companies and many in the medical community are now going to tell you it’s genetic — a disease of the brain that results in an insatiable hunger. They do this because surgeries and weight loss drugs are profitable. In this lesson, we will address these issues one by one.

programme.title: Relationships with Marianne Williamson - Relationships: Overcoming the Ego Mind
programme.desc: In the following lesson, we'll discover how the ego mind influences both our way of thinking and our relationships. We'll also identify the unconscious barriers we've built that cause us to form these judgments and thoughts. That's where the problem is, and that's where the solution lies.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Calories: Everything You Need to Know
programme.desc: Let’s use a quick analogy: If your body is a car, then reverse is actively gaining weight, neutral is not gaining or losing, and drive is weight loss… Ultimately you have been eating more than you are burning, which is what put the weight on in the first place. By controlling the calories in, we generally shift the car from reverse to neutral. No longer gaining, but not really losing a ton. By adding exercise into the mix we throw the car into drive without compromising your metabolism or muscle mass.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Balancing Hormones for an Optimized Metabolism
programme.desc: This lesson discusses the connection between hormones and metabolism. The goal here is to get your hormones in balance, which will regulate your appetite, optimize your BMR, and help you maintain lean body mass. The good news is that to do this we don’t need a deep dive on each and every hormone because what’s good for one hormone is typically good for all of them. Meaning, the recommendations in this lesson help bring your entire body into balance — so you don’t have to deal with each hormone on a case-by-case basis.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - The Relevance of Macros & Micros
programme.desc: At long last you have arrived at the diet section of this course. And while technically this episode is about food quality, this is where Jillian answers all your questions about popular fad diets. Keto, Carnivore, Paleo, Pegan, Vegan, Vegetarian, Low Fat, Intermittent Fasting, Low Glycemic. Which is best?! Find out what matters most for weight loss.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - The Role of Exercise in Weight Loss
programme.desc: Finally, the exercise episode! Exercise is the most powerful lever you can pull when it comes to longevity, health, and weight loss. It’s also the number one form of preventative medicine and helps prevent yo-yo dieting. Here Jillian provides clear guidelines for how much and what types of exercises you should be building into your weekly routine.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Why Do We Have Insatiable Hunger?
programme.desc: Hopefully by now you understand that you gain weight because you have eaten more energy than you have burned in your day and stored that energy in your fat cells. But, have you ever wondered WHY you are overeating — i.e. eating more than you are burning? Why do we have such insatiable appetites when our bodies are usually pretty good at staying in balance? And no… it’s not because you have no willpower. This episode digs into where the physiological and psychological hunger is coming from — and how to cope with it.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Way Beyond Willpower: Managing Relationships and Environments to Beat Temptation
programme.desc: Willpower is like a muscle: If you use it long enough without a break, it fatigues. It’s the moment at the Mexican restaurant when they go to drop the chips and you say, 'No thanks.' If the chips sit on that table, there is no chance you won’t end up eating the basket. So, let’s go over some basic techniques you need to program into your behavior and environment to safeguard yourself against momentary vulnerabilities. We also cover some serious boundary setting, so get ready.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Cheat Codes
programme.desc: There are certainly things that can add a plus to our A, but these aren’t replacements for eating better and moving more. Nothing in this lesson will come close to impacting your results like diet and exercise. Nonetheless, Jillian offers her thoughts on cold exposure, heat exposure, and supplements.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Your Complete Weight-Loss Plan
programme.desc: A big goal (if you have one) can feel a bit intimidating or overwhelming. This episode is here to help remove any of those anxious feelings with something called a goal pyramid. This simple technique will help you know exactly what to do and when to make that vision a reality!

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency - Section 1: The Addiction Frequency & The Power of Breath

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency - Section 2: Importance of Morning & Evening Practices
programme.desc: If you take care of the bookends of the day, the rest of the day will take care of itself. It’s such a powerful idea for people to understand that when we wake up in the morning, most people wake up with anxiety, fear, and negativity. So, we need to do something right away to set ourselves straight, to create the conditions for the best day possible, regardless of the circumstances that we're facing in the outside world.

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency - Section 3: The 3 Minds NEW
programme.desc: Addiction is felt and experienced in the mind. The mind is a terrible master but a wonderful servant. We must understand its functions as it’s an important aspect of addiction recovery and learning how to thrive. So, the key question is this: How do you get the mind to serve the heart, rather than staying trapped in serving the mind? Only heightened awareness can end the inner war.

Don’t worry, we aren’t going down a biochemistry rabbit hole here. These are just the must-know essentials.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Calories: Everything You Need to Know
programme.desc: Let’s use a quick analogy: If your body is a car, then reverse is actively gaining weight, neutral is not gaining or losing, and drive is weight loss… Ultimately you have been eating more than you are burning, which is what put the weight on in the first place. By controlling the calories in, we generally shift the car from reverse to neutral. No longer gaining, but not really losing a ton. By adding exercise into the mix we throw the car into drive without compromising your metabolism or muscle mass.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Balancing Hormones for an Optimized Metabolism
programme.desc: This lesson discusses the connection between hormones and metabolism. The goal here is to get your hormones in balance, which will regulate your appetite, optimize your BMR, and help you maintain lean body mass. The good news is that to do this we don’t need a deep dive on each and every hormone because what’s good for one hormone is typically good for all of them. Meaning, the recommendations in this lesson help bring your entire body into balance — so you don’t have to deal with each hormone on a case-by-case basis.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - The Relevance of Macros & Micros
programme.desc: At long last you have arrived at the diet section of this course. And while technically this episode is about food quality, this is where Jillian answers all your questions about popular fad diets. Keto, Carnivore, Paleo, Pegan, Vegan, Vegetarian, Low Fat, Intermittent Fasting, Low Glycemic. Which is best?! Find out what matters most for weight loss.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - The Role of Exercise in Weight Loss
programme.desc: Finally, the exercise episode! Exercise is the most powerful lever you can pull when it comes to longevity, health, and weight loss. It’s also the number one form of preventative medicine and helps prevent yo-yo dieting. Here Jillian provides clear guidelines for how much and what types of exercises you should be building into your weekly routine.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Why Do We Have Insatiable Hunger?
programme.desc: Hopefully by now you understand that you gain weight because you have eaten more energy than you have burned in your day and stored that energy in your fat cells. But, have you ever wondered WHY you are overeating — i.e. eating more than you are burning? Why do we have such insatiable appetites when our bodies are usually pretty good at staying in balance? And no… it’s not because you have no willpower. This episode digs into where the physiological and psychological hunger is coming from — and how to cope with it.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Way Beyond Willpower: Managing Relationships and Environments to Beat Temptation
programme.desc: Willpower is like a muscle: If you use it long enough without a break, it fatigues. It’s the moment at the Mexican restaurant when they go to drop the chips and you say, 'No thanks.' If the chips sit on that table, there is no chance you won’t end up eating the basket. So, let’s go over some basic techniques you need to program into your behavior and environment to safeguard yourself against momentary vulnerabilities. We also cover some serious boundary setting, so get ready.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Cheat Codes
programme.desc: There are certainly things that can add a plus to our A, but these aren’t replacements for eating better and moving more. Nothing in this lesson will come close to impacting your results like diet and exercise. Nonetheless, Jillian offers her thoughts on cold exposure, heat exposure, and supplements.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Your Complete Weight-Loss Plan
programme.desc: A big goal (if you have one) can feel a bit intimidating or overwhelming. This episode is here to help remove any of those anxious feelings with something called a goal pyramid. This simple technique will help you know exactly what to do and when to make that vision a reality!

programme.title: Good Mood Food with Jason Wrobel - Mood Disorders & Depression
programme.desc: Today, Jason’s getting vulnerable with you. He shares his personal story of how he was diagnosed with clinical depression and his journey into healing. His protocol includes supplements, new foods, meditation, and somatic therapy.

programme.title: Gut Health with Dr. Mary Pardee - Day 10: Test, Don't Guess
programme.desc: For day 10 we learn about the different kinds of tests that give us insight to one's gut symptoms. Knowledge is power!

programme.desc: What could a hormone imbalance look like for you?

programme.desc: Today we learn which tests you should be pursuing for a total view of your heart health and how to synthesize those results systemically.

programme.title: Grounding Into Grace - Jump In With Both Feet
programme.desc: If you want to build a dynamic yoga practice from the ground up, we must start with the feet. This class encourages you to open and awaken the many muscles of the feet before moving through a flowing sequence of standing postures. End class with hamstring lengthening and a gentle, restorative backbend.

programme.title: Grounding Into Grace - Full Body Ground Control
programme.desc: In a dynamic vinyasa yoga practice you are constantly shifting your point of grounding — from the feet, to the hands, to one foot and one hand, to the hips, and on and on. This class starts moving and doesn't stop for 25 minutes, challenging your focus and balance as you seamless weave through a tapestry of movement. The last 15 minutes, however, are reserved for some long slow hip openers. This is just reward for making it not just through this dynamic class, but for having the tenacity to stick with our collective 10-day adventure. Bravo!

programme.desc: As humans, we are constantly struggling between the poles of what we think we want and what is. When we lose touch with the truth of what is, we create and compound our suffering. What narratives are you constructing? Are they in conflict with the truth of the situation? Are you struggling with what is?

We can become so wrapped up in our recollections, we convince ourselves of these untruths. Is that person a monster? Were they wishing you harm? Or were they dealing with a difficult situation in the best way they knew how?

programme.title: Gut Health with Dr. Mary Pardee - Day 5: GERD and Food Sensitivities
programme.desc: Healthy gut, healthy brain. For day 5, we learn how certain GI disorders affect brain functionality.

programme.title: Gut Health with Dr. Mary Pardee - Day 6: The Gut Microbiome
programme.desc: For day 6 we learn about gut bacteria, how to optimize them, and how they affect our health both positively and negatively.

programme.desc: For day 7 we learn the difference between prebiotics and probiotics and when to supplement our current diet with probiotics.

programme.title: Gut Health with Dr. Mary Pardee - Day 8: Hormones and your Gut
programme.desc: For day 8 we learn how sex hormones, and thyroid and adrenal glands affect gut health.

programme.title: Gut Health with Dr. Mary Pardee - Day 9: Diet for a Healthy Gut
programme.desc: For day 9 we'll learn about gut-specific healthy ways to eat, and supplements that can help us digest certain foods properly.

programme.title: Yoga For All - Day 6: Clarity
programme.desc: Your day 6 practice invites you to use core work to get clear. In this session we use controlled movement to activate the muscles of the abdominal for a strong and healthy back and strengthen your whole self.

programme.title: Commune Meditation Summit - CMS - Preethaji
programme.desc: Every one of us, at any point in time, is living in one of two states of being. We are either in a suffering state or we are living in a beautiful state. When you are in a beautiful state of connection, you enter a new realm where synchronicities unfold, where the randomly moving universe arranges itself into patterns to fulfill your heart's desires. Use this meditation practice to manifest heart-felt intentions in your life.

programme.title: Commune Meditation Summit - CMS - Tracee Stanley
programme.desc: In this grounding meditation, allow yourself to let go and relax your mind and body so you can slip into a state of deep rest and rejuvenation.

programme.title: Commune Meditation Summit - CMS - Danielle LaPorte
programme.desc: Appreciation is a form of wellness. It’s also what keeps us moving through difficult times and what brings us back to love time and again. More importantly, when you tie your gratitude to the “why” of it, you develop new forms of appreciation and depths of connection for living.

programme.title: Commune Meditation Summit - CMS - Sharon Salzberg
programme.desc: Today, we're going to be talking about opening to joy. programme.title: Commune Meditation Summit - CMS - Light Watkins
programme.desc: In this lesson with Light Watkins, you will learn to examine bliss as more than a buzzword. You’ll come to see and know it as a powerful state of presence that is accessible through the practice of meditation.

programme.title: Commune Meditation Summit - CMS - Kimberly Snyder
programme.desc: Today, you will learn how to tap into your unwavering inner knowing, which is also and often called your intuition. Kimberly Synder shares why being connected to your inner source of beauty is so important.

programme.title: The Superpowers of Your Gut - The Superpowers of Your Gut - Day 1
programme.desc: Human biology is a symphony played between the body and the greater nature around us. The great conductor of that symphony, in many ways, is the gut and microbiome. This course will take a multifaceted look at this organ system � which is our primary interface with the chemistry of the world � so you can get an understanding of how to co-create health and well-being.

programme.title: The Superpowers of Your Gut - The Superpowers of Your Gut - Day 2
programme.desc: You have an intimate relationship with everything you put in your mouth. The tongue is a magical instrument for you to start to remember the power of flavor and nutrients, to slow it down and experience food again.

programme.title: The Superpowers of Your Gut - The Superpowers of Your Gut - Day 3
programme.desc: The esophagus is simply a tube that runs from mouth to stomach, moving food from one to the other. And yet, as we dig into its structure, we find an extraordinarily complicated and intricate organ that has a deep relationship to the beauty of the body. The reality of this simple tube ends up displaying the sheer miracle of a day in the life of a human being.

programme.title: The Superpowers of Your Gut - The Superpowers of Your Gut - Day 4
programme.desc: In terms of its surface area and musculature, the stomach is designed to listen to your food. What is your stomach listening to? It�s listening to how your food was grown, lived, and died. It�s picking up on the microRNA that was in your food right at the moment you consumed it.

programme.title: Yoga For All - Day 7: Prana
programme.desc: Your Day 7 practice is an invitation right to the good stuff. This fiery session is a warming sequence that guides to you create a healthy flow of energy in the body welcoming total mind and body health.

programme.title: Yoga For All - Day 9: Bold
programme.desc: Your day 9 practice asks you to check in with body and breath as a way of cultivating more awareness. The journey continues! The vocabulary grows. Move fearlessly through this practice by simply listening to your body. Check your habits and move with intention as a way of moving forward with confidence and focus.

programme.title: Vinyasa for Life - Vinyasa for Life: Easing into Back Bending
programme.desc: Establish long term success for your practice by learning about one of the most crucial body parts in yoga—your spine. In this class Schuyler teaches you how to backbend safely, followed by three practical applications. Class ends with a soothing restorative posture. Body awareness never felt so good.

programme.title: Vinyasa for Life - Vinyasa for Life: From Cobra to Camel
programme.desc: This vinyasa class applies what you learned in Day 1 so you can play with classic backbends and steady transitions. Schuyler guides you through Cobra (Bhujangasana), Locust (Salabhasana), and Camel (Ustrasana), finishing off with Bridge (Setu Bandhasana) and spine-clearing twists. Take it slow and build strength!

programme.title: Vinyasa for Life - Vinyasa for Life: Foundations of Forward Bending
programme.desc: In this class, you begin with a brief anatomy of forward folds, followed by a dive into Standing Forward Fold (Uttanasana) and Wide-Legged Forward Fold (Prasarita Padottanasana). Regardless of your flexibility, this lab is designed to help you to safely find length through the entire back chain of your body.

programme.title: Vinyasa for Life - Vinyasa for Life: Forward Bending for Forward Thinking
programme.desc: Use what you learned in Day 4 to stretch the hamstrings and your backbody safely and effectively. Bring attention to your spine in Downward Facing Dog (Adho Mukha Svanasana) and Intense Side Stretch (Parsvottanasana), before working on Hand-to-Big-Toe Pose (Padangusthasana) with a strap. Finish in a supported backbend to counter your diligent forward folding.

This course will take a multifaceted look at this organ system � which is our primary interface with the chemistry of the world � so you can get an understanding of how to co-create health and well-being.

programme.title: The Superpowers of Your Gut - The Superpowers of Your Gut - Day 2
programme.desc: You have an intimate relationship with everything you put in your mouth. The tongue is a magical instrument for you to start to remember the power of flavor and nutrients, to slow it down and experience food again.

programme.title: The Superpowers of Your Gut - The Superpowers of Your Gut - Day 3
programme.desc: The esophagus is simply a tube that runs from mouth to stomach, moving food from one to the other. And yet, as we dig into its structure, we find an extraordinarily complicated and intricate organ that has a deep relationship to the beauty of the body. The reality of this simple tube ends up displaying the sheer miracle of a day in the life of a human being.

programme.title: The Superpowers of Your Gut - The Superpowers of Your Gut - Day 4
programme.desc: In terms of its surface area and musculature, the stomach is designed to listen to your food. What is your stomach listening to? It�s listening to how your food was grown, lived, and died. It�s picking up on the microRNA that was in your food right at the moment you consumed it.

programme.title: Yoga For All - Day 7: Prana
programme.desc: Your Day 7 practice is an invitation right to the good stuff. This fiery session is a warming sequence that guides to you create a healthy flow of energy in the body welcoming total mind and body health.

programme.title: Yoga For All - Day 9: Bold
programme.desc: Your day 9 practice asks you to check in with body and breath as a way of cultivating more awareness. The journey continues! The vocabulary grows. Move fearlessly through this practice by simply listening to your body. Check your habits and move with intention as a way of moving forward with confidence and focus.

programme.title: Vinyasa for Life - Vinyasa for Life: Easing into Back Bending
programme.desc: Establish long term success for your practice by learning about one of the most crucial body parts in yoga—your spine. In this class Schuyler teaches you how to backbend safely, followed by three practical applications. Class ends with a soothing restorative posture. Body awareness never felt so good.

programme.title: Vinyasa for Life - Vinyasa for Life: From Cobra to Camel
programme.desc: This vinyasa class applies what you learned in Day 1 so you can play with classic backbends and steady transitions. Schuyler guides you through Cobra (Bhujangasana), Locust (Salabhasana), and Camel (Ustrasana), finishing off with Bridge (Setu Bandhasana) and spine-clearing twists. Take it slow and build strength!

programme.title: Vinyasa for Life - Vinyasa for Life: Foundations of Forward Bending
programme.desc: In this class, you begin with a brief anatomy of forward folds, followed by a dive into Standing Forward Fold (Uttanasana) and Wide-Legged Forward Fold (Prasarita Padottanasana). Regardless of your flexibility, this lab is designed to help you to safely find length through the entire back chain of your body.

programme.title: Vinyasa for Life - Vinyasa for Life: Forward Bending for Forward Thinking
programme.desc: Use what you learned in Day 4 to stretch the hamstrings and your backbody safely and effectively. Bring attention to your spine in Downward Facing Dog (Adho Mukha Svanasana) and Intense Side Stretch (Parsvottanasana), before working on Hand-to-Big-Toe Pose (Padangusthasana) with a strap. Finish in a supported backbend to counter your diligent forward folding.

programme.title: Yoga For All - Day 7: Prana

programme.desc: This is not a religious course; rather, it’s a universal system based on love. You think you have many different problems, but you have only one — the illusion of your separation from God, the true nature of reality. We get trapped in illusions (and create our own suffering) when we over-identify with a particular problem or stay stuck in fear-based thinking. This program is here to remind you of a key universal principle: Only love is real.

programme.title: Spiritual Makeover with Marianne Williamson - Spiritual Makeover - Part 4
programme.desc: The ego asks, ‘Who are you to dream big?’ Spirit is ready to show you the answer when you are ready to see all that is possible.

programme.title: A Strong & Stable Spine - Check Your Neck, Volume 1
programme.desc: This class primarily focuses on increasing the flexibility and suppleness of your cervical spine (the top 7 vertebrae, otherwise known as your neck). We tend to neglect the neck when we practice/train. It has the tendency to be stiff and weak. So, before we practice some strength building mobility work in the next class, let's stretch it out and create some more space in the areas that tend to hold tension. Get your strap out and get ready for some yummy, feel-good stretches that lengthen the tissues of your neck in 360 degrees.

programme.title: A Strong & Stable Spine - Check Your Neck, Volume 2
programme.desc: Now that we've stretched out our necks and created some space in this area, let's add some mobility work to the mix. Most of us tend to focus on strengthening bigger muscles and more obvious joints like our shoulders and hips, and our neck tends to get left out and neglected. This class is all about strengthening the neck in 360 degrees.

programme.title: A Strong & Stable Spine - Boulder Shoulders
programme.desc: The shoulders are the seat of the neck. They influence the way it moves and positions itself in space. When we strengthen and stabilize the shoulders we free up room for better mechanics in the neck. This class will take you on a journey in all the directions the shoulder can mobilize. Let's go.

programme.title: A Strong & Stable Spine - Flexion Section (Abdominals)
programme.desc: A strong stable core is truly the foundation for proper movement mechanics. Most of us are stuck in spinal extension. Our ribs flare out and our lower back is overly compressed. We need to learn how to access our abdominal muscles through articulating our spine into flexion. Here's a class that will toughen up your abdominal muscles, and teach you how to flex and segment your spine efficiently.

programme.title: Break Out of the Addiction Frequency - Section 1: The Addiction Frequency & The Power of Breath
programme.desc: Breathing is the single most important thing we do. Addiction is characterized by a sense of lack, of missing something. And when you breathe poorly, like when anxious or angry, you’re caught up in your head and aren’t breathing well and that sends a signal to your body that perpetuates the addiction frequency. Deep, long breathing is how we interrupt this pattern.

programme.title: Yoga For All - Day 2: Befriend
programme.desc: Your Day 2 session invites you to use the tools of the at-home yoga practice to befriend your body and your breath. Build on the art of noticing from Day 1 as we expand our vocabulary with a focus on a strong foundation. This session encourages a healthy flow of energy up and down the spine and lovingly guides you to learn how to take responsibility for your experience on the mat.

programme.desc: What if I told you there was a reason you feel tired, achy, and foggy all the time? And what if I told you the solution was healing your body on the cellular level?

programme.title: Balance Your Hormones with Dr. Jolene Brighten - Balance Your Hormones - Day 1: Hormones 101
programme.desc: Your hormones work like a symphony. When every instrument is in tune, they play harmoniously. However, if one instrument is out of tune, or one hormone is out of balance, the entire piece is thrown off. Together, we'll decode your symptoms and work with your body to create hormonal balance. This means clear skin, easier periods, less hot flashes, better sex, and more restful sleep. Yes, it can be that good when your hormones are in check.

programme.title: Balance Your Hormones with Dr. Jolene Brighten - Balance Your Hormones - Day 2: Adrenal Glands
programme.desc: This sentence sums it up: The adrenal glands are the foundation of hormone balancing. If your adrenals aren't functioning at full capacity, you'll feel it. In today's lesson, we take a deep dive into the hormones that our adrenal glands produce. We'll start to get an idea of why taking care of and keeping these glands happy is so important.

programme.title: Balance Your Hormones with Dr. Jolene Brighten - Balance Your Hormones - Day 5: Estrogen
programme.desc: You can thank estrogen for keeping your lips full and plump and your body curvy. Today, we take a deep dive into the importance of estrogen, how it impacts our body, and the effects of having too much or too little can have on your health. You'll also learn ways to support your body's estrogen production, such as seed cycling, bioidentical hormone replacement therapy, and even by having more orgasms.

programme.title: Balance Your Hormones with Dr. Jolene Brighten - Balance Your Hormones - Day 3: The Thyroid
programme.desc: How common are thyroid conditions? Women are 5 to 8 times more likely than a man to develop thyroid disease. If your thyroid isn't functioning optimally, every single cell in your body will feel it, including your ovaries. A thyroid function that is too high or too low can lead to symptoms that include low heart rate, fatigue, weight loss, and menstrual irregularities.

programme.title: Balance Your Hormones with Dr. Jolene Brighten - Balance Your Hormones - Day 4: Progesterone
programme.desc: When it comes to having a calm, chilled-out mindset or the sweet feelings of love, you can thank progesterone. On the flip side, suboptimal levels of this hormone can cause you to have headaches, breast tenderness, inability to fall asleep, and painful or heavy periods. Together, we'll learn what you can do to get your body producing the right amount of progesterone. Because this hormone is everything when it comes to feeling at peace.

programme.title: Balance Your Hormones with Dr. Jolene Brighten - Balance Your Hormones - Day 9: Detoxification
programme.desc: Did you know that 80,000 toxic chemicals have been released into the environment since the Industrial Revolution? What's worse is that very few have been tested for their long-term impact on human health. Today's session is all about detoxification, the natural process that our liver, kidneys, lungs, lymphatic system, gut, and skin perform daily to get rid of metabolic byproducts that our body produces and toxins that are absorbed from the environment. You'll learn how to avoid toxins and how to address those that you already are carrying due to the nature of the environment, as well as how to optimize your body's ability to detoxify.

programme.title: Hacking Your Healthcare - Day 5: Heart Health
programme.desc: Today we learn which tests you should be pursuing for a total view of your heart health and how to synthesize those results systemically.

programme.title: Hacking Your Healthcare - Day 7: Hidden Inflammation and Disease
programme.desc: We’ve all experienced inflammation in some form. Today we address how to find this hidden symptom, identify it and its root causes, and stop it in its tracks. There is no optimal health with uncontrolled inflammation.

programme.title: Good Mood Food with Jason Wrobel - Fat is Your Friend
programme.desc: Don’t demonize fat. It’s actually your friend! Today, you will learn the importance of the quality of the fat you’re consuming, how to select the right kind of monounsaturated fats that nourish your brain, and why it’s important to choose the right cooking oils.

programme.title: Good Mood Food with Jason Wrobel - Mindfulness Practices for Mealtime
programme.desc: We’ve all heard about the importance of being present—but how does that translate to meal time? Today is all about how to practice presence at every meal by feasting with your other senses first, and how to recognize how food actually makes you feel.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Cheat Codes
programme.desc: There are certainly things that can add a plus to our A, but these aren’t replacements for eating better and moving more. Nothing in this lesson will come close to impacting your results like diet and exercise. Nonetheless, Jillian offers her thoughts on cold exposure, heat exposure, and supplements.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Way Beyond Willpower: Managing Relationships and Environments to Beat Temptation
programme.desc: Willpower is like a muscle: If you use it long enough without a break, it fatigues. It’s the moment at the Mexican restaurant when they go to drop the chips and you say, 'No thanks.' If the chips sit on that table, there is no chance you won’t end up eating the basket. So, let’s go over some basic techniques you need to program into your behavior and environment to safeguard yourself against momentary vulnerabilities. We also cover some serious boundary setting, so get ready.

programme.title: Weight Loss Master Class - Weight Loss Master Class - Your Complete Weight-Loss Plan
programme.desc: A big goal (if you have one) can feel a bit intimidating or overwhelming. This episode is here to help remove any of those anxious feelings with something called a goal pyramid. This simple technique will help you know exactly what to do and when to make that vision a reality!

programme.title: A Strong & Stable Spine - 360 Degrees Hips
programme.desc: The hips are the seat of the lower back. If you have low back pain, you will benefit from strengthening and stabilizing the various articulations of the hips. This class will take you on a journey of the hip joint in 360 degrees. When the hips are strong they serve as a foundation for your entire spine. Your spine will move better, function better and feel better when it has the support and stability of the hips.

programme.desc: Today we learn which tests you should be pursuing for a total view of your heart health and how to synthesize those results systemically.

programme.title: Hacking Your Healthcare - Day 7: Hidden Inflammation and Disease
programme.desc: We’ve all experienced inflammation in some form. Today we address how to find this hidden symptom, identify it and its root causes, and stop it in its tracks. There is no optimal health with uncontrolled inflammation.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie - My Mother Terrifies Me
programme.desc: The way you recall a memory and the way it actually happened might be completely different. The question is, do you know which version feeds you? We can become so wrapped up in our recollections, we convince ourselves of these untruths. Is that person a monster? Were they wishing you harm? Or were they dealing with a difficult situation in the best way they knew how?

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie - I Want to Be Famous
programme.desc: Stop focusing on the object of your desires and start focusing on the reason for desiring that object in the first place. When you turn it around, you may find that what you really want is completely different than what you’ve been telling yourself.

programme.title: The Work of Byron Katie - My Husband Doesn't Want Me as a Business Partner

programme.title: The Wellness Master Class - The Wellness Master Class: Cultivating Joy

The other is long term and lasting, sustained by gratitude and a life of meaning and purpose. If we’re waiting on joy to enter our life, we’re not living as connected or congruent as we could be.
